title: Pet-Fee Refund Amount: Computation Memo
content:
# Pet-fee refund — computation memo

**Clause.** On a cancelled reservation in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category that recorded a pet fee, the pet-fee refund counts the pet-refundable nights, the nights dated after the cancellation date and before the check-out date less the nights the pet-fee refund leaves out for notice, and it leaves out 1 of them. The share of the pet fee returned is the nightly amount refunded on the same cancellation divided by the stay's nightly subtotal. The pet-fee refund is the pet fee recorded on the stay times that share, rounded half up to the cent, and it is paid to the guest's card in full.

## Terms used

- **Cancellation date** — the date part of the cancellation time recorded on the stay.
- **Pet-refundable nights** — the nights dated after the cancellation date and before the check-out date, less 1, never below zero. For a cancellation dated before check-in, the nights after the cancellation date and before the check-out date are all of the stay's nights.
- **Nightly amount refunded on the same cancellation** — the nightly refunds with the guest-cancellation reason that the stay's ledger shows.
- **Pet fee recorded on the stay** — the pet fee in the stay's price breakdown frozen at booking.

## Worked figure (hypothetical stay)

| Input | Value |
|---|---|
| Nights | 8 |
| Cancellation | dated on the fourth night |
| Pet-refundable nights | 4 nights after the cancellation date, less 1, that is 3 |
| Nightly subtotal | 800.00 |
| Guest-cancellation nightly refund on the ledger | 300.00 |
| Pet fee recorded on the stay | 60.00 |

Share returned: 300.00 divided by 800.00, that is 0.375. Pet-fee refund: 60.00 times 0.375, which is 22.50, paid in full to the guest's card.

A stay whose ledger shows no guest-cancellation nightly refund has a share of 0 and a pet-fee refund of 0.00.
